name: ECA Field Widget Actions
description: Integrate ECA with the Field Widget Actions module.
project_description: ECA Field Widget Actions bridges the ECA (Events, Conditions, Actions) engine to the Field Widget Actions module. Field Widget Actions attaches buttons to field widgets on entity forms; this module turns a button click into an ECA event (the 'ECA Field Widget' event), so a site builder defines what the button does with an ECA model rather than custom code. The model receives the entity being edited, the field name and the field index (delta) as event context, and returns a value through the 'Set field widget value' action. That value is either offered in the Field Widget Actions suggestions dialog or, when 'Fill the field directly' is enabled, written straight into the widget: text/CKEditor widgets get a string, select lists and checkbox/radio groups get a value list, and compound fields (Address, Link, Smart Date, Custom Field) get a mapping of property names, applied by rebuilding the widget from the entity. Typical uses are content suggestions, AI-assisted field filling, and on-demand data lookups.
